'''Republic Fleet Command''', alternatively known as '''Naval Command''', was the primary leadership of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the era of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Galactic War]], overseeing the operations of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]].
